status: kept: typed track-load failures and exact coincident disks preserve full-board completion
owning_layer: Hyperdrc KiCad source adapter; existing geometry::circle_region owns disk construction
retention_rationale: Retain for explicit malformed-source failure and exact coincident-disk completion, above performance, memory and size in the governing ladder. The unchanged ordinary64 instrumented samples show slower median loading; the unchanged CPArti samples require more allocation calls and bytes. All adverse observations and artifact growth are retained. Previously materialized output is preserved and both original full-board resource gates pass. The additional HVP109A geometry changes the completed workload. No speedup or lower-resource claim is made.

intentional_migration.source_failure: Required start/end/width fields are validated exactly; missing, malformed, duplicated, extra-valued or negative widths return a typed TrackLoadError through the existing anyhow Result instead of omitted/defaulted/truncated geometry. Shared exhaustion is preserved as BudgetExceeded. No partial board is published.
intentional_migration.coincident_tracks: Exact rational endpoint equality selects the existing native circle constructor with radius width/2. Five formerly omitted HVP109A tracks now form certified disks; finite coincidence of distinct source endpoints remains an explicit failure.
intentional_migration.other_positive_track_failures: Valid positive source that the legacy finite adapter cannot construct is an explicit unsupported/native-geometry failure; it is not counted as certified geometric completion.
intentional_migration.version: Readiness CHECK_IMPLEMENTATION_VERSION 20 to 21. All raw selected CLI report differences are recorded and confined to this field on the measured corpus.
intentional_migration.legacy_tests: Two complete original fixtures are byte-identical. One now requires the exact disk; the incomplete fixture requires typed MissingField(end) and separately preserves its pad/via/zone checks. Their original failed expectations remain in candidate v1.
intentional_migration.archived_carrier: The unchanged 26-test native-stroke file expects failed regions for some malformed/budget cases; the new public contract returns a load error instead. Its complete result and first failures remain visible.

candidate-v1: HVP109A load rejection in both original board gates
candidate-v2: missing imports prevented unit/workload compilation; 39 public tests and docs passed

limitations: Noncoincident tracks still use the legacy finite rectangular adapter. General round caps, exact source-coordinate fidelity and extreme noncoincident strokes remain open; local predicate certainty does not certify that source fidelity.

The new typed failure boundary covers straight-track start/end/width and their construction. Other object families, layer/net validation, the full error taxonomy, end-to-end provenance, and structured machine-readable CLI errors remain open.

Input parsing, exact coefficient growth, total work, heap bytes and cancellation have no new internal bound. Shared work-budget checks preserve existing denial, but do not bound parsing. Runs use external time/address-space limits; allocator requests and process RSS do not measure expression depth or prove a heap-byte bound.

HVP109A loads now include five additional disks. Their costs are retained as changed-workload observations, not a same-contract speed comparison. Instrumented matched samples for unchanged inputs do not establish uninstrumented production latency or a universal performance claim.

The archived native-stroke tests stop at their first failed assertion; no credit is claimed for later unexecuted checks. Their remaining failures and the rejected 35-file integration remain preserved.

The published-package user path, minimum compiler, complete pre-push/CI matrix, all-property audit and measured coverage remain incomplete. No push was performed; KiCad loading has no affected C/JS/WASM binding consumer in this patch.
The inherited physical artifact audit remains failed/incomplete with 27093 missing paths. Fresh paths are audited independently without a whole-history or zero-loss claim.

prepare_candidate_v2.py printed only its two test-path variables in the short terminal summary; its result.json correctly records all five changed paths and the complete source hashes. The inaccurate short summary is preserved, not used as a source inventory.
next: Continue ordinary strict native-stroke completion and exact source fidelity using the preserved original regressions and unchanged workload gates; do not restore the rejected integration wholesale.
Extend visible failures and provenance through the remaining modeling/format boundaries, then complete clean external distribution, release/workflow validation and the remaining properties.
